headlines.description: — Austin Riley hit a three-run homer off All-Star closer Jhoan Duran in the eighth inning and the Atlanta Braves rallied past the Philadelphia Phillies 5-3 on Tuesday in the opener of a best-of-three National League Wild Card Series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Austin Riley's 3-run homer off Jhoan Duran rallies Braves past Phillies 5-3 in NLWCS opener

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery hit a solo homer and Sam Antonacci drove in two runs to lead the Chicago White Sox over the Houston Astros 6-3 in Game 1 of an AL Wild Card Series on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox strike first in AL wild card, beating Astros 6-3 in Game 1

events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Cam Schlittler pitched another playoff gem against the Boston Red Sox, and Ben Rice also burned their hometown team with a late grand slam and six RBI as the New York Yankees opened this Wild Card Series rematch with a 9-0 victory Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schlittler and Rice torment hometown team as Yankees beat rival Red Sox 9-0 in playoff opener

tuneInPrompt.title: Cycle Watch
tuneInPrompt.caption: Ben Rice is a triple away from the cycle.
tuneInPrompt.shortText: Ben Rice is a triple away from the cycle.

headlines.shortLinkText: Padres rout Cubs 8-0 in emphatic Wild Card opener with Tatis' leadoff homer, King's no-hit bid
